cast: Lily (girl, 9), her brother Tom (6), Mum, Dad, Grandma, Grandpa, Lily's classmate Mia, cousin Sam (10) and the puppy Max. Numbers and counting. On this island a picture may show one big, clear number (like 7 or 4th) as the main subject; nothing else written.

more: Tom runs ninety metres in the park.

我们走一百米去学校。

more: Tom opens his present first.
Tom 首先打开他的礼物。
This is my first day at school.
这是我上学的第一天。

等十秒。
